6. Cash Position

Noventra Digital LLC reported closing cash of AED 2,450,000 as at 30 June 2026, against a
minimum operating cash requirement of AED 3,000,000, resulting in a cash shortfall of AED
550,000.
Customer collections amounting to AED 780,000 were received in July 2026 rather than June.
The company also paid AED 320,000 for infrastructure maintenance earlier than budgeted.
7. Financial Commentary
Velmora Energy LLC
Velmora Energy LLC reported renewable infrastructure efficiency gains of AED 450,000 and
sustainable resource recovery savings of AED 275,000 during Q2 2026.
Its additional maintenance expenses amounted to AED 85,000 during the same quarter.
Meridian Technologies
Meridian Technologies generated revenue of INR 18.5 crore and net profit of INR 3.2 crore for
FY 2025. Its operating expenses amounted to INR 95 lakh.
Eurovanta Solutions
Eurovanta Solutions recorded capital expenditure of EUR 1.450.000,50 during FY 2025.
Lumivex Industries
During Q2 2026, Lumivex Industries spent AED 180,000 on digital infrastructure upgrades.
The company forecasts revenue of AED 8,500,000 for Q3 2026.
8. Forecast and Target Performance
Entity: Noventra Digital LLC.
Currency: AED.
Q3 2026
Financial Indicator Q3 2026 Target
Forecast
Revenue 20,500,000 22,000,000
Net Profit 3,850,000 4,200,000

9. Additional Financial Information
Noventra Digital LLC reported administrative expenses of AED 2026 during Q2 2026.
Velmora Energy LLC recognized corporate tax expense of AED 180,000 for Q2 2026.
The applicable corporate tax rate was 9%.
10. Administrative Information
Noventra Global Holdings was established in 1998.
Document Version: 2.1.
Internal approval reference: 78542.
The management report was approved on 20 July 2026.
Management expects the new regional office to open in September 2026.
No additional funding has been requested from the Group at this stage.
End of Report
